summary: Tested 6 NEW items (7-12) for this round plus regression checks. Backend: 6/6 new pytest tests passed covering item 9 (Test User exclusion + permanent is_public=false guard for @mtree.dev on manifestation creation) and item 10 (fresh-user streak_reminder_enabled default True + opt-out works) + item 7 field presence. Frontend: verified via live browser automation on Expo web preview - item 7 badges (Donated/Affirmation/Hustle Linked) render on both wall list card and detail sheet always showing explicit Yes/No/On/Off; item 8 confirmed no testimony/story text anywhere in detail sheet; item 9 confirmed only 'mj rd' shown on wall, no 'Test User'; item 10 confirmed fresh @mtree.dev user's Settings 'Remind me daily' toggle is ON by default with 8:00 PM time, and opt-out toggle works; item 11 confirmed via code review + measured DOM heights that Cycle/Reminders/Affirmation/Hustle/Fasting cards all share styles.choiceCard (minHeight:78) giving a consistent uniform sizing band (cycle cards measured exactly 78px each; toggle cards 78-98px depending on 1 vs 2 lines of text, which is expected content-driven variance, not a jump/shrink bug); item 12 confirmed splash screen (app/index.tsx) shows ONLY the tree icon + 'GOAL · INTENTION · SACRIFICE' tagline, no 'mTree' wordmark text. Regression: Home card order (Moon+Cosmic -> Deity(Zorath) -> Streak -> Affirmation -> Your Journey) confirmed with Streak card visible without scrolling; 'Best 0' streak label text renders correctly; Wall save/filter previously verified still functioning (used in item 7/8/9 flows).
action_items: No blocking fixes required. All 6 new items (7-12) verified working end-to-end via backend pytest + live UI automation.

Testing note (not a bug): FilledButton in manifest-setup.tsx (and reused ui.tsx component) uses onPressIn instead of onPress (documented as a deliberate Android/Reanimated workaround). Playwright's standard .click() (which fires mousedown+mouseup+click) did NOT reliably trigger onPressIn on this preview environment - had to use explicit page.mouse.down()/wait/mouse.up() sequences to advance the manifest-setup wizard steps. This worked fine and is likely just a Playwright/RN-Web quirk, not a real user-facing issue (real touch/mouse-down would fire onPressIn normally), but flagging in case future testing agents hit the same 'Continue button seems unresponsive' symptom - use mouse.down()+mouse.up() instead of .click() for this specific button pattern.
critical_code_review_comments: wall.tsx InfoBadge component correctly renders Donated/Affirmation/Hustle Linked on both the list card (line ~210) and DetailPanel (line ~413) using the exact same component/props pattern, always showing explicit value text regardless of true/false (never conditionally hidden) - matches item 7 spec exactly.
wall.tsx DetailPanel has zero testimony/story rendering left (confirmed via source read and live DOM text extraction) - fully removed per item 8.

server.py create_manifestation (line 596-597) forces is_public=False for any @mtree.dev account even when client payload requests is_public=True - verified live via pytest that a freshly created+manifested item never appears on GET /api/community/wall afterward. _test_account_user_ids() (line 776) provides defense-in-depth exclusion on both /community/wall and /community/leaderboard queries.

UserProfile default streak_reminder_enabled=True (line 135) + AuthContext.tsx/settings.tsx both use the `!== false` pattern (not `=== true`) so any legacy/undefined value on old users also defaults to enabled - correct forward-compatible default logic.

manifest-setup.tsx: Cycle (line 290), Busy Hours (line 396), Affirmation (line 514), Hustle (line 558), and Fasting choice cards all share styles.choiceCard = { minHeight: 78, justifyContent: 'center' } (line 674) - single shared style guarantees no drastic size jump between steps; small height variance (78-98px) across steps is purely due to differing amounts of text content (title-only vs title+subtitle vs marginTop spacing), not inconsistent sizing logic.

app/index.tsx splash screen uses a dedicated icon-only PNG asset (gen_logo_a_constellation_v2_secondary.png) with no wordmark baked into the image or rendered as separate Text - item 12 correctly implemented.
seed_data_creation: Multiple fresh @mtree.dev test users created during this session (all disposable, prefixed testfresh*/testsetup*/TEST_freshuser_* - safe to ignore/leave, no impact on real user data). One extra active manifestation created on the existing test@mtree.dev account for the Home-card-order regression check (goal=money/sacrifice=sugar/21 days, is_public correctly forced to false server-side, left active/not deleted since no user-facing delete endpoint exists - harmless as it's private and abandons automatically if another manifestation is started).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dev-login + localStorage.setItem('mtree_session_token', JSON.stringify(token)) + page.reload()/goto() pattern confirmed working again. IMPORTANT UI-testing tip: manifest-setup.tsx's 'Continue' button (and other FilledButton instances) use onPressIn not onPress - use page.mouse.move()+mouse.down()+wait+mouse.up() instead of page.click() to reliably advance wizard steps in Playwright against this Expo web preview. Also for off-screen chip options (e.g. sacrifice category 'Sugar' which is far down a long scrollable chip list), must scroll_into_view_if_needed() before computing click coordinates, otherwise the click silently lands off-screen and the selection doesn't register even though the element technically exists in DOM. test@mtree.dev currently has one active (not manifested) manifestation left over from this session's regression check.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable - no bugs found in items 7-12. All new features implemented correctly per spec. The only notable finding was a testing-tool-level interaction quirk (onPressIn vs click()) documented above, not an application bug.
